metadata.note: Command teardown of ./art smoke — the dispatcher case at art:100-102 that execs runtime/scripts/smoke_test.sh with $@ forwarded (no flags exist). smoke_test.sh builds the examples/_smoke/ fixture in a throwaway mktemp scratch dir (cp -R FIXTURE/. WORK/), runs Kokoro narration (generate_audio_kokoro.py), then run.sh (which routes through GATE L beat-mix lint, GATE SHAPE, the zero-Manim skip path, the no-Remotion skip path, compile.py's slate pass, and GATE V frame-level QC — ART_STRICT=0 so GATE V's canvas-fill/negative-space MAJORs on the deliberately bare slates do not stop the build), and lands a compiled slate mp4 on disk. Then it verifies the DECODED output: GATE SIZE > 20000 bytes, GATE TYPE = ffprobe decodes both a video and an audio stream, GATE AUDIO = ffmpeg volumedetect on the compiled mp4's own audio track shows mean_volume > -40 dB. The fixture ships as two deliberately bare narration slates so the render+compile stages get exercised end to end without needing a full Remotion project (that's the point — a green ./art doctor confirms deps import; a green ./art smoke proves the mp4 renders and can be decoded). Verbatim demo captured on this workstation shows both the current-shipped failure (the tip-of-tree examples/_smoke/beat_sheet.json has metadata.slug='_smoke', which the recent build_safety.validate_project regex '[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*' rejects — smoke_test.sh exits 1 at GATE 0 with 'REFUSED: metadata.slug must be a filename, not a path', even though ./art doctor on the same box reports every FEATURE green) and the reproduction of the pass path (the fixture slug is patched in a work copy to satisfy the regex — 636229-byte smoke-slate.mp4, video+audio streams, mean_volume -24.2 dB). No paid API, no upload, no network calls; a local .mktemp-shim/mktemp wrapper reroutes smoke_test.sh's mktemp -d output from the App-Sandbox-blocked /var/folders default into $TMPDIR (smoke_test.sh itself is not modified). Playlist adaptation for @HumanitariansAI: composer folder chip reads @HumanitariansAI; outro card is the locked ClaudeTitleOutro with hardcoded @NikBearBrown handle per OUTRO-LOCK.md — flagged for the human reviewer before publication. episode.source_sha256 cf4037bbf6d98fd50f59af03b0ccf1a020822f94c7d3f0a021382d8144c80831.

beats.role_note: FRAMEWORK 2 — the pipeline smoke_test.sh drives and the three decoded gates it verifies.
beats.narration_text: What smoke_test.sh actually does. It copies the tiny fixture at examples slash underscore smoke into a throwaway scratch directory, then walks it through the real pipeline — Kokoro narration, then run dot sh's render and compile pass, then three verify gates on the compiled mp4 that actually lands on disk. Size — greater than twenty thousand bytes. Type — ffprobe decodes both a video and an audio stream. Audio — ffmpeg volumedetect reads a mean volume above negative forty decibels. Every one of those numbers comes out of the DECODED file, not the process exit code.

props.title: smoke_test.sh — one pipeline, three decoded gates
props.code:
# Setup — a throwaway scratch dir so re-runs never dirty examples/_smoke:
FIXTURE="$REPO/examples/_smoke"
WORK="$(mktemp -d 2>/dev/null || mktemp -d -t art-smoke)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
cp -R "$FIXTURE/." "$WORK/"

# Pipeline — the real one every reel goes through:
python3 "$ROOT/scripts/generate_audio_kokoro.py" "$WORK"          # narrate
ART_FACTS=0 ART_QC=1 ART_STRICT=0 bash "$ROOT/scripts/run.sh" "$WORK"  # render + compile

# Verify — three gates that read the DECODED mp4 on disk:
OUT="$WORK/_smoke-slate.mp4"
[ "$(wc -c < "$OUT")" -gt 20000 ]                                         # GATE SIZE
ffprobe -show_entries stream=codec_type -of csv=p=0 "$OUT" | grep -q video # GATE TYPE
ffmpeg -i "$OUT" -af volumedetect -f null - 2>&1 | grep mean_volume        # GATE AUDIO
props.sparkLine: Scratch dir. Real pipeline. Three decoded gates.

beats.role_note: FALSIFIABILITY — the shipped-fixture regression captured verbatim on this box. Recovery: patch the fixture slug (or the regex).
beats.narration_text: One failure worth showing — the real one on tip of tree today. Run art smoke against the shipped fixture and it exits one at GATE zero, before Kokoro even loads. The reason is not a missing dependency. It is a static validator, added recently to fail closed on unsafe slugs, that rejects the fixture's own slug because it starts with an underscore. And this is exactly why art smoke exists. Art doctor on the same box is all green — the imports are fine — but the pipeline cannot render this fixture. Recovery is a one-line patch: rename the fixture slug from underscore-smoke to smoke, or widen the regex to accept the fixture the toolkit ships with. Fix that one thing and the same pipeline lands a green mp4.

props.title: recovery   (verbatim; shipped fixture on tip of tree)
props.code:
# BEFORE — run against the fixture the toolkit actually ships:
$ ./art smoke
[smoke] building examples/_smoke in /tmp/…/art-smoke.2940021608
[smoke] --- GATE 0: Kokoro narration ---
[kokoro] REFUSED: metadata.slug must be a filename, not a path
[smoke] FAIL: generate_audio_kokoro.py failed — see …/.audio.log
[exit $?] = 1

# WHY — build_safety.py:186-187
if not isinstance(slug, str) or not re.fullmatch(
     r'[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*', slug):
    raise BuildError('metadata.slug must be a filename, not a path')

# examples/_smoke/beat_sheet.json ships with:  "slug": "_smoke"
# The leading underscore does not match the anchor class [A-Za-z0-9].

# RECOVERY — one line, either side of the seam:
#   (a) rename the fixture slug:   "slug": "smoke"   (drop the underscore)
#   (b) OR widen the regex to accept a leading underscore in the fixture.

# AFTER — same pipeline, one character patched:
[kokoro] beat-B00.mp3  8.73s  voice=af_bella
[art] wrote $WORK/smoke-slate.mp4  (13.9s)
[smoke] SMOKE PASS — examples/_smoke built a real, watchable slate cut end to end.
[exit $?] = 0
props.sparkLine: One char. Fixture blocked. Doctor still green. Fix: rename.

beats.role_note: VERDICT — the whole surface, in the order you use it.
beats.narration_text: So — art smoke. The end-to-end proof. One dispatcher case, no flags. It builds a bare fixture in a throwaway scratch dir, drives it through Kokoro and run dot sh's real skip paths, and then reads the compiled mp4 back from disk with three decoded gates. It exits zero when SIZE, TYPE, and AUDIO all clear. Run it after art doctor whenever you touch anything in the render or compile paths. A green art doctor means the deps import. A green art smoke means a fellow can actually make a video today.
